title: D2C product brand
tagline: Your own label — apparel, beauty, home, gadgets — sold through your website, marketplaces and quick commerce.
who: Founders launching a branded physical product
Private-label sellers moving from reselling to their own brand
Teams planning to raise angel or VC money

structure.why: Brands build enterprise value and raise money; a company holds the trademark, issues ESOPs and takes investment cleanly. The 22% concessional rate (25.17% all-in) and DPIIT recognition sweeten it. Expect ₹40,000–1 lakh a year in audit and ROC compliance.
structure.alternatives: LLP if you will stay bootstrapped and family-owned; proprietorship only for a test launch before committing.

breakdown: Incorporation incl. DSCs, stamp duty, professional fee: ₹8,000–25,000

timeline: Incorporation 7–15 working days; GST a further 3–30; marketplace accounts 2–7 days each; first sellable, labelled stock typically 6–10 weeks from today.
taxes: Corporate tax 25.17% all-in under the concessional regime (or 25% + surcharge/cess default); dividends taxed in founders’ hands.
GST at the HSN rate on every sale (5%/18% after the 2025 rationalisation); marketplaces deduct 0.5% GST TCS and 0.1% income-tax TDS on your sales.

Place of supply = delivery state; inter-state B2C sales attract IGST — your GSTIN handles it, no registration needed in every state unless you stock goods there (Rule 14B from Nov 2026 lets small sellers use the marketplace warehouse as PPoB).
TDS on your own payments: contractors, designers, rent, influencer fees (194C/194J/194H).
selling: Own store on Shopify/WooCommerce with Razorpay/Cashfree
Quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) via brand onboarding once you have velocity
Instagram/WhatsApp commerce; ONDC through a seller app
sourcing: Contract manufacturers in clusters: Tirupur/Ludhiana (knits, hosiery), Surat/Jaipur (fabrics, prints), Noida/Gurugram (apparel), Delhi/Mumbai (cosmetics contract manufacturers with CDSCO licence), Moradabad (metalware), Agra/Kanpur (leather)
Imports from China/Vietnam for electronics and accessories — budget BIS, duty and labels
B2B platforms: IndiaMART, Udaan, Alibaba; always sample and sign a spec sheet
pitfalls: Launching without a trademark search — rebranding after traction is the most expensive mistake on this path.
Labels missing MRP inclusive of taxes, net quantity, manufacturer/packer address or country of origin — marketplaces delist and Legal Metrology fines per SKU.
Ignoring the 1 January 2027 e-commerce amendments: ‘was’ prices must be the lowest of the last 30 days; best-before and return-shipping terms must be shown.
Treating marketplace payouts as revenue — reconcile TCS/TDS credits monthly or you overpay tax.
Skipping INC-20A, the auditor appointment or DIR-3 KYC in year one — ₹100/day penalties pile up silently.
